instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Core is a specialized temperature-controlled logistics provider specializing in the pharmaceutical and fresh food distribution across Iberia. The company manages complex supply chains utilizing 50 refrigerated trucks and extensive cold storage, ensuring strict regulatory compliance for highly sensitive goods.
answers.pastInitiatives: The company has maintained a stable operational model focused on optimizing existing routes rather than systematic transformation or new product development. While leadership is aware of market shifts, there are no documented initiatives for R&D spending or formal prototyping. Innovation efforts have been ad-hoc and reactive.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago, requiring systematic exploration of adjacent markets like high-value controlled cold storage solutions. This goal necessitates exploring new customer segments in sectors outside traditional pharma/food distribution and identifying potential acquisition targets to achieve diversification.
answers.additionalContext: Core currently relies heavily on established operational efficiencies rather than technology-driven differentiation. The primary technical limitation is the lack of integrated data analytics, which hinders predictive maintenance and scalable service offerings.
answers.teamSize: Our R&D function consists of 10-12 engineers organized into two squads: one focused on core product innovation and one on exploratory/new business model prototyping. We also have 2 dedicated data engineers building our analytics infrastructure. Innovation projects follow a lean startup methodology with clear go/no-go criteria at 3-month checkpoints.

opportunities.title: IoT Sensor Integration for Predictive Cold-Chain Alerts
opportunities.rationale: Implementing real-time temperature monitoring sensors across the fleet can offer immediate operational improvements and reduce spoilage risks, aligning with conservative risk parameters. This is a low-risk technical upgrade that provides actionable data.

first_actions: Conduct a pilot program on 5 key routes using existing vehicle telemetry capabilities.
Identify specific vendor solutions for sensor integration and communication protocols.
resources_needed: €150,000 for hardware and software integration licenses
Allocation of 2 full-time engineers (from R&D squad)
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce spoilage incidents by 15% within Q3.
milestones: Month 1: Pilot completion & KPI baseline established.
Month 3: Full fleet integration planning and budget approval.

opportunities.title: Strategic Acquisition of Niche Cold Storage Asset
opportunities.rationale: To achieve diversification rapidly, acquiring a small specialized cold storage facility in a non-traditional sector (e.g., advanced biotech/research) provides immediate market entry and service expansion without extensive internal development time.

first_actions: Identify three potential acquisition targets matching the 25% diversification criteria.
Develop a preliminary valuation model focusing on synergistic cross-selling opportunities.
resources_needed: Legal counsel retainer for due diligence
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful acquisition of one target achieving 10% of new revenue within 12 months.
milestones: Month 2-4: Target identification and preliminary outreach.
Month 6: Formal valuation and negotiation phase.

opportunities.title: Develop a Tier-2 Predictive Maintenance Model
opportunities.rationale: Leveraging the existing data engineering capabilities to create simple predictive models for truck engine and refrigeration unit failure can reduce unexpected downtime, improving operational resilience.

first_actions: Clean and consolidate historical maintenance logs across all 50 trucks.
Prototype a machine learning model focusing on temperature spikes correlated with mechanical stress.
resources_needed: Internal reallocation of 1 data engineer's time (part-time)
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve a 20% reduction in unscheduled maintenance events.
milestones: Month 4: Data pipeline fully operational and model trained.

next_steps.action: Form an Innovation Steering Committee and define the scope for the Strategic Acquisition target screening.
Initiate the pilot program for IoT sensor integration to establish a baseline for operational efficiency gains.

key_weaknesses: Complete absence of a formal, systematic innovation process leads to reactive rather than proactive market positioning.
Low digital maturity (Level 2) limits the ability to leverage modern data analytics for predictive decision-making and scalability.
High competitive pressure coupled with high operational costs makes organic growth initiatives extremely difficult within a short time horizon.
